Edit ONLY this file — never the generated views.

layers.desc: Claude Code · Codex CLI · Gemini/Antigravity — where you actually chat

layers.desc: one core rules file, deployed to every tool via adapters

layers.label: Plugins & Skills
layers.desc: your marketplace + third-party stores + vendored toolkits

layers.label: MCP Servers
layers.desc: bridges from tools to capabilities (browser, data, docs)

layers.label: Pipelines & Automation

layers.label: Products

components.name: opcos
components.purpose: The agent operating system itself: core governance rules, plugin marketplace, install scripts, and this registry.
components.when_to_use: Always — the foundation of everything; the FIRST thing a new machine installs.

components.name: your-company-skills
components.purpose: Self-written skills for your domain workflows, plus the operational skills of the framework itself (adopt-repo, system-audit, config-gc).
components.when_to_use: Your domain work + operating the framework.
components.install: claude plugin install your-company-skills@opcos (install script does this)

components.name: review-pack
components.purpose: Cherry-picked and locally modified engineering skills: security review, language-specific reviewers, testing patterns.
components.when_to_use: Code review, security escalation per core rules.
components.update: manual cherry-pick from upstream (the copy has diverged — never pull blindly)

components.name: path-bound-toolkit
components.purpose: An upstream toolkit that hard-codes its own install path and self-updates, so it cannot be packaged into the marketplace.
components.when_to_use: Only in the one tool it supports; the exception that proves the storage law.
components.install: install script clones upstream directly (see bootstrap/install.template.ps1 step 4)

components.name: browser-automation-mcp
components.purpose: Browser automation for UI testing and dogfooding local apps.
components.when_to_use: UI tests and app dogfooding — NOT for performance measurement (use a devtools-grade MCP for that; see the role-split in core rules).

components.name: local-tts-engine
components.location: ~/.tools/tts (venv + GPU runtime; models in HF cache)
components.purpose: Offline text-to-speech engine used for narration in media pipelines.
components.when_to_use: Any narration work; too heavy to live inside the repo — hence homegrown-outside.
components.install: copy folder + its own install.ps1 (creates venv, downloads models)

components.name: nightly-report-pipeline
components.purpose: Scheduled automation that renders and publishes a nightly report through your notify channel.
components.when_to_use: Runs on schedule at autonomy tier auto-safe; publishing steps remain human-gated until promoted to full.
components.install: copy folder + register the scheduled task through your notify wrapper

components.name: legacy-notes-plugin
components.purpose: Old note-taking plugin, superseded by your memory workflow.
components.when_to_use: REMOVED 2026-07-01 (uninstalled, folder soft-deleted to trash) — entry kept for the audit trail.

components.name: your-product
components.purpose: Your product repo — the thing all these agents actually work on.
components.when_to_use: Daily; follows its own project rules file, which overrides the global core rules.
components.install: git clone + follow the repo's own setup docs
